dose_equivalence: Match free and mixture to measured nominal total active drug mass on the loaded carrier; released fraction and kinetics recorded separately. Numeric active-drug concentrations remain blank until loading is measured.
planning_assumptions: 96-well reader, three technical replicates and three independent campaigns are a proposal for feasibility and variance estimation, not a powered confirmatory sample size. Separate destructive assays per time and matching cell-free interference plates. Extra physical-mixture arm is proposed, not agreed by the laboratory.

power_scenarios.endpoint: paired natural-log IC50 loaded/free, only when both IC50 are identifiable
power_scenarios.assumptions: Independent normal paired log-ratios, common predeclared time; conservative Bonferroni planning across three candidates. Technical wells do not increase n. Values of effect and SD are hypothetical scenarios, not measurements.
